title: Puzzle 3D Vortex Show Window Options
description: Puzzle 3D vortices must only be visible when their parent object is hovered or selected. Hide vortex markers otherwise so the scene stays uncluttered; keep vortices interactive once the object is engaged via hover/selection (and when a vortex on that object is itself hovered/selected so vortex-only selection still works).
summary: Puzzle 3D vortex markers are no longer always on. `world_vortices_json` now emits vortices only when the parent object is hovered or selected, or when any vortex on that object is itself hovered/selected (so vortex-only selection and connect/brush still work). The React world host keeps the connect-drag source marker visible if the parent loses hover mid-drag. Covered by `world_vortices_only_emit_for_hovered_or_selected_objects`; related vortex selection tests still pass.
